notes: Seasonal holidays for scripts/systems/holidays.gd. 'day' is the day of the season (1-based; -1 = last day, clamped to the season length). Every folk gets the holiday's 'buff' while it lasts plus the hidden 'holiday_today' marker; 'whim' is injected into the Goals whim table; 'party_bonus' is added to the score of Story parties each game hour; objects with any of decor.tags near a folk (>= decor.min_count) grant 'festive_home'.

new_year.label: New Year's Dawn
new_year.notify: New Year's Dawn! A fresh year begins - celebrate with friends.

whim.label: Toast the new year with someone
